plugins.name: jvm-diagnostics-cli
plugins.description: Serviceability-tool-first skills for diagnosing running JVMs via local jcmd/jps/JFR: process discovery, process inspection, JFR capture/analysis, and thread/heap leak diagnosis

plugins.name: jvm-diagnostics-jolokia
plugins.description: Jolokia-MCP-first skills for diagnosing a remote JVM over JMX-via-HTTP when there's no local jcmd/SSH access: DiagnosticCommand operations, JVM inspection, thread/heap leak diagnosis, and JFR capture/streaming
